{{Quote|Roona seconds the motion for a vote of no confidence in Chancellor Valorum.|Senator Edcel Bar Gane|<ref name="TPMn" />}}
'''Roona''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|109|Roona}}</ref> located in the [[Roona system/Legends|Roona system]], a part of the [[Bes Ber Bikade sector/Legends|Bes Ber Bikade sector]] in the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was situated on the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], which linked it to the [[Arquata Station system/Legends|Arquata Station]], [[Borkyne system/Legends|Borkyne]], and [[Epica system/Legends|Epica systems]].<ref name="TEA" /> Roona shared its name with the [[Roonan lemon]] [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]].<ref name="Dex">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>

Roona was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by<ref name="TPMn" /> the [[Roonan/Legends|Roonan]]<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]],<ref name="TPMn" /> who held the position from as early as [[34 BBY/Legends|34 BBY]]<ref name="Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> to as late as [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].<ref name="22 BBY">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|news/13411_7.html|Senator Tikkes Jumps Bail}} is set both during [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane's]] term as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] and on the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] "13:4:11," which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="32 BBY">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> Bar Gane was the first to formally second the motion for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in the Republic's [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] proposed by [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Amidala]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="TPMn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Roona was first mentioned in [[Terry Brooks]]'<ref name="TPMn" /> [[April 21]], [[1999]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|novelization]] of<ref name="YearByYear">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref> the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']],<ref name="TPMn" /> which was released on [[May 19]] of the same year.<ref name="YearByYear" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Roona [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the planet Roona, in grid square L-15.<ref name="TEA" />
